title: R3/R4-series districts (pitched-roof envelope, ZR 23-421) - maximum perimeter-wall height and maximum ridge/building height
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the pitched-roof envelope HEIGHT constraints for the R3/R4-series districts enumerated in NYC Zoning Resolution section 23-421 (City of Yes, Last Amended 2024-12-05). Section 23-421 applies ONE uniform pitched-roof envelope to a single enumerated district list (R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A); this rule scopes that envelope to the R3/R4-series members of that list (R3A, R3X, R3-1, R3-2, R4, R4-1, R4A) via in_set - mirroring the accepted r1-r2-r3-residential-far precedent of grouping the districts the source itself groups under one value. R1/R2 (group labels; blocker B-023) and R5A (accepted M4-T006 pilot) are intentionally excluded. Two SEPARATE typed constraints are emitted, both measured ABOVE THE BASE PLANE: maximum perimeter-wall height (25 ft) and maximum ridge/building height (35 ft). FAIL-CLOSED INPUT: applicability is conditional on BUILDING TYPE (single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line per 23-421); the canonical property_profile exposes NO building-type field, so building_type is a REQUIRED input with no canonical source - when it is missing/unavailable the evaluation returns professional_review_required with NO value (this is also the pitched-vs-flat envelope selection failing closed for R3-2 and R4, which ALSO have a flat 23-422 envelope). The setback above the perimeter wall is governed by the sloping-plane (apex-point, <=80-degree pitch) geometry of 23-421, NOT a flat numeric depth; it is surfaced as a documented limitation (A2 gap, D-045-R008), never reduced to a number. NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A ... Perimeter walls are subject to setback regulations at a maximum height above the base plane of 25 feet. ... These planes start at the maximum permitted height of the perimeter walls and meet at a ridge line of 35 feet above the base plane.

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations of a building or other structure shall be as set forth in Section 23-421 (Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts) and 23-422 (Basic flat-roof envelopes for certain districts). ... The height of all buildings or other structures shall be measured from the base plane.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability is the R3/R4-series subset of the 23-421 pitched enumeration (in_set R3A/R3X/R3-1/R3-2/R4/R4-1/R4A); R1/R2/R5A and every other district are NOT matched (visible not_applicable). District SCOPE is enforced by applicability, not an input-domain enum.

inputs.name: building_type
inputs.description: Building type. REQUIRED and FAIL-CLOSED: no canonical property_profile field exposes building type, so in practice this is unavailable and the evaluation returns professional_review_required with no value. The pitched-roof envelope applies only to the source-named single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line forms (section 23-421); those values make this rule applicable. The non-pitched values 'attached'/'other' are the engine's representation of 'residences not subject to the provisions of Section 23-421' (section 23-422's own negative definition; NOT source-named building types) - for R3-2/R4 they route to the SEPARATE flat rule r3-2-r4-flat-height and here yield a visible not_applicable, so the pitched-vs-flat selection is explicit and never guessed.

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.commercial_overlays[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.special_districts[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: historic_district
inputs.description: True iff the lot is in a designated Historic District (section 23-426); when a caller supplies true -> professional_review_required.

outputs.name: max_perimeter_wall_height
outputs.description: Maximum perimeter-wall height (ft) ABOVE THE BASE PLANE (section 23-421). Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result.

outputs.name: max_building_height
outputs.description: Maximum ridge/building height (ft) ABOVE THE BASE PLANE (section 23-421). Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result.

parameters.name: perimeter_wall_height_ft
parameters.note: Maximum perimeter-wall height 25 ft above the base plane (section 23-421), uniform across the enumerated R1-R5A pitched districts. Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

parameters.name: ridge_height_ft
parameters.note: Maximum ridge/building height 35 ft above the base plane (section 23-421), uniform across the enumerated R1-R5A pitched districts. Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

steps.note: Maximum perimeter-wall height above the base plane (section 23-421).
Maximum ridge/building height above the base plane (section 23-421).

exceptions.description: The setback above the perimeter wall is governed by the sloping-plane / pitched-roof geometry of section 23-421 (apex points, sloping planes at up to 80 degrees rising from the 25 ft perimeter-wall plane to the 35 ft ridge), NOT a flat numeric depth. It is not reduced to a single number here (A2 gap, D-045-R008) and requires professional review.
A commercial overlay may modify residence-district height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
A mapped special district may modify height (section 23-44); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
In a designated Historic District the perimeter-wall height may be required to match adjacent buildings (section 23-426); the citywide value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
Heights are measured ABOVE THE BASE PLANE (section 23-421 / 23-42), not above curb; the base-plane determination is a separate professional input.
Applicability requires a building type (detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line) that has no canonical property_profile field; without it the rule fails closed to professional_review_required.

The setback is pitched-plane geometry (23-421 paragraphs a-g), not a flat depth; it is surfaced as a documented limitation / professional review (A2 gap, D-045-R008), not a numeric setback constraint.

R3-2 and R4 also carry a FLAT-roof envelope (section 23-422, 35 ft max building height) selected by building type; that is a SEPARATE rule (r3-2-r4-flat-height). R4B is flat-only (r4b-height). R3A/R3X/R3-1/R4-1/R4A have NO flat-roof counterpart in 23-422.

The section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site / qualifying-senior-housing increase and the section 23-425 large-site modification are conditional alternatives not modeled here (A2 gaps, geography/eligibility dependent); the section 23-421 5-ft reference-plane provision applies only to R1/R2 without a letter suffix and is out of scope.
